exposure: type of heart disease (congenital heart disease, valvular heart disease, cardiomyopathy)
cohort: 389 pregnant women with confirmed heart disease managed at a tertiary referral center in Iran between March 2017 and March 2023.
finding: Structured multidisciplinary care and mWHO-based risk assessment may contribute to improved maternal and fetal management in pregnant women with cardiac disease in low- and middle-income country settings.
mod_finding: Cesarean deliveries were common, accounting for 53% of deliveries in the cohort.
followup_time: until hospital discharge after delivery or pregnancy termination
